_file_note: Notes for app/data/model/room_seat.json: where each field came from, who writes and reads it, and the rules it must obey. The field's type, allowed answers, required-ness and column type live with the class in app/models/. Merged by app/repositories/model_catalogue_repository.py.
about: One seat in a panel or sim room: a person (library persona or custom agent) plus the fields the room adds when it is built. The person part is checked against model/persona.json or model/custom_agent.json; these are the room's own fields.
rules: Money fields are computed from real persona data when the room is built, never by the model.
A grant detected at room build writes income_provenance 'grant_schedule' over the persona's own; that value is a room value, not a persona one.

id.note: Seat number in this room. The library id is library_id.

lsm_proxy.note: Copied from the library's in-memory load stamp. Not read from seats.

segment_id.note: Which picked group seated this person (panel_service.SEGMENTS).

chat_state.note: Follow-up chat memory, kept apart so the person stays as built.
